changelog:
Global Overlay Back Control—auto-hiding oval back button on all fullscreen overlays. Tap screen in Weather, Dream Clock, Minimal Clock, Quick Entities to reveal floating back button at top edge. Auto-hides after inactivity. One tap returns to main dashboard. Critical for Facebook Portal, tablets, wall-mounted panels. Thanks @janstadt.

Sidebar Experience Upgrade—reorder entries via long-press drag in Settings → Sidebar Settings. Voice Memo, Browser, Weather, Clock, Quick Entities, Camera, Mic Mute, Dark Mode all rearrangeable.

Facebook Portal Permissions Fix—Meta Portal Support module updatable via AvaMod. Unlocks ambient light, presence detection, sound level, screen timeout, notification tone sensors. Supports ADB, Shizuku, or root auto-permission. Entry: Settings → Mod Store → Meta Portal Support; Settings → Super Permissions → Shizuku. Thanks @janstadt.

Fixes: soft keyboard in browser inputs on locked devices #85 @itsgreat2misha; sidebar touch handling in browser overlay; z-order management across overlays; Quick Entities back behavior from fullscreen browser; screensaver/clock/weather scaling on non-standard sizes; HA/MA logo positioning in media overlays; Sendspin display glitches; WebView edge cases; missing icon assets. More long-uptime stability fixes.
